description: Answers the endpoint-reachability challenge: makes one outbound, Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)-guarded, per-host rate-limited HTTPS GET to this draft's declared URL and re-records whether it responded successfully - repeat calls re-run the same probe and simply re-record its current result, which can change if the endpoint's reachability changes. Requires the access code.

accessCode.description: The one-time access code returned by self_register_agent_card for this draft.

id.description: The draft's id, as returned by self_register_agent_card.

title: Check Self-Registration Endpoint Challenge
